B3/2026-07: BEST-DESIGNED drug-ALONE post-washout cognitive test in HEALTHY adults. n=89, psilocybin 25/10mg vs placebo; CANTAB global composite AND every domain null at day 29, with cognition a DESIGNED (not exploratory) endpoint. Decisive against drug-alone durable enhancement in an intact brain.

B3/2026-07: RATE-NOT-LEVEL negative. Modafinil + 10 cognitive-training sessions in healthy adults bought learning RATE (AUC 24.7 vs 12.3, ES 0.84) but placebo CAUGHT UP by the final session; no group difference in retention decay (F=0.2, p=0.65); ZERO transfer to MCCB/Cogstate. Warns that scoring a learning curve manufactures a rate effect and misreads it as durability.

B3/2026-07: SIGN FLIP BY ASSAY. A single 5mg donepezil dose REDUCED the monocular-deprivation ocular-dominance shift in healthy adults, t(11)=-4.9, p<0.001 -- OPPOSITE in sign to its reported effect on perceptual learning, in the same species and cortical area. A plasticity property that flips sign by readout is not a molecular property; this is why the window label must be ASSAY-INDEXED (B2).

B3/2026-07: THE SCALE FAILURE of drug x training. FLAME (n=118) measured ON DRUG at day 90 and never contained post-washout evidence; three pre-registered replications took the pooled motor effect to cOR 0.96 across n=5907 (Cochrane 2021 SMD 0.03, HIGH GRADE). AFFINITY 12-month timepoint, 6 months after cessation: cOR 0.93.
